backSections.heading: Our Mission
backSections.body: We believe that 6G base stations will run almost entirely in software. We are driving this transformation by developing hardware accelerators that boost physical layer processing on standard CPUs. This provides just the right efficiency to turn 5G and 6G radio access networks (RANs) into an App. Optimized for open-source RANs and free of CPU vendor lock-in, our accelerators return technological sovereignty to the community.

backSections.heading: Open RAN and Open Source
backSections.body: We develop O-RAN-compatible 5G & 6G networks. Drawing on our unique expertise in the deep integration of hardware and software, we cover the entire value chain in the development of radio units.

backSections.heading: Platform for AI RAN Processing
backSections.body: Our RPU offers API to AI RAN developers: AI RAN Apps can run deep in the RAN and exchange data directly with radio access functions.

backSections.heading: Large-scale networks
backSections.body: ORS acts as a technology partner for system integrators in the construction of large-scale 5G and 6G networks.

backSections.heading: Engineering & Consulting
backSections.body: ORS offers engineering and consulting services in the field of software-defined radio (SDR), hardware acceleration and O-RAN networks  flexible solutions to protect against jamming and spoofing attempts in wireless communications..

quote:
ORS is built on deep technical expertise in mobile communications, hardware-software co-design and system design. As software-defined radio (SDR) and digital signal processing (DSP) enthusiasts, we are revolutionizing the infrastructure of mobile networks. We believe that 6G radio access networks (RANs) will run almost entirely in software - on the ground and direct-to-cell from orbit.
We are driving this transformation by developing software-defined radio units (RUs) with minimal fixed hardware that boost physical layer processing on standard CPUs. This provides just the right efficiency to turn 5G and 6G radio access networks (RANs) into an App.
